response.answer: Prof. María Martinón-Torres is a leading expert in Pleistocene hominin studies, focusing on taxonomy and evolutionary scenarios. She directs CENIEH and is a member of the Atapuerca Research Team. Her work analyzes early human dispersals in western Europe.
